snippet.title: Barbarous 3: Family Secrets | Official Trailer | Play Now
snippet.description:
Emyr, your favourite barbarian invites you to join him on a new adventure, filled with humorous awkward moments and thrilling action. After winning the tavern wars, Emyr got to know where his lost wife is now. He closed his tavern and went on the road with Lysella, to find Kintara. In their journey, they will encounter multiple obstacles that might lead them to lose track of their emotions. However, if they wish to reach their goal and ensure a brighter future, they need to overcome their weaknesses and emerge victorious. Will their struggle be futile? Can they succeed in defeating the ultimate evil? Help Emyr save the world in a Time Management game full of adventure and comedy!  

🔍 Play Now! [ https://go.onelink.me/SPl0 ]
